attchmntText: DCM Shriram Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30.09.2026,
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram Industries Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 7th November 2026. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion following a limited review. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, total income was 31,169 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 1,302 lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share were 1.50. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, total income was 61,149 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 1,457 lakhs. Earnings per share were 1.67. The company operates in the sugar and distillery segment. Figures for earlier periods were restated due to a Composite Scheme of Arrangement effective in FY 2025-26. Newspaper publications were released on 8th November 2026.

attchmntText: DCM Shriram Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram Industries Limited has adopted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 07 November 2026. The statutory auditors, BSR & Co. LLP, issued an unmodified opinion following a limited review. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported net sales of 30,933 lakhs and a net profit after tax of 1,302 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 1.50. For the six-month period, net sales were 60,221 lakhs with a net profit after tax of 1,457 lakhs. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 amounted to 96,873 lakhs. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
